column1: # census 文案表：census.ps1 与 census.sh 共用这一份（收敛计划 C2）。
# 格式：每行 key<TAB>lang<TAB>text，UTF-8（不带 BOM）、LF 行尾。以 # 开头的行和空行会被忽略。
#   · text 原样输出，不做任何转义；不能包含 TAB 或换行。首尾空格有意义（如 dirt.join 的 " and "），编辑器不要自动去掉。
#   · {name} 是占位符，由调用处传入的事实替换。
#   · lang 目前是 zh / en；每个 key 两种语言都必须有（tests/check-text.ps1 会检查）。
#   · key 前缀 ps1: / sh: 表示只给对应实现用、并覆盖同名的无前缀 key。
#     现在只用于两边措辞尚未统一的几条（PATH_DIRT 文案、bootstrap 脚本名），统一留给收敛计划的 C4。
#   · 只有一个实现会用到的 key 也直接写在这里，另一个实现不会查它们。

1. 声明层 —— 谁在要求哪些工具与版本
1. Declarations — who asks for which tools and versions
2. 纳管层 —— mise 管理的工具
3. 约定层 —— 带版本号的命名 shim（最容易失传的约定）
3. Conventions — version-suffixed shims (the kind that gets lost)
4. 工具清单 —— 磁盘上实际存在的运行时与工具（含纳管与未纳管）
4. Inventory — runtimes and tools actually present on disk (managed or not)
5. 解析层 —— 命令实际解析到哪
5. Resolution — what each command actually resolves to
6. 告警 —— 需要人工确认的问题
6. Warnings — things that need a human decision
性能分解 —— 各阶段耗时

.sh syntax check: docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/w" -w /w bash:latest sh -c "bash -n scripts/*.sh"
命令 '{command}' 解析到 '{path}'，实测无法执行（运行 --version 无输出、退出码 9009）。这类文件是 Windows 应用执行别名，目标应用没装时执行会静默失败，而 Get-Command / where.exe 都会把它当成可用命令。

'{command}' resolves to '{path}', which cannot actually run (probing --version gives no output, exit code 9009). This is a Windows app-execution alias: when the target app is missing the call fails silently, yet Get-Command and where.exe both list it as usable.
换用其它命令，或安装该别名对应的应用
Use another command, or install the app behind the alias
声明要求 {tool} {wanted}（{file}），mise 也装有 {have}，但 '{command}' 解析到 '{path}'（{version}）。未激活 mise 的场景（cmd、图形程序、IDE 任务、-NoProfile 脚本）会用到错版本；根因是 PATH 组合顺序，不是运行时本身有问题。

'{file}' asks for {tool} {wanted} and mise has {have}, but '{command}' resolves to '{path}' ({version}). Contexts without mise activation (cmd, GUI apps, IDE tasks, -NoProfile scripts) get the wrong version — the root cause is PATH ordering, not the runtime itself.
交互式会话里 mise activate 会把 shims 前置来救场；要让所有场景都对，需要把 shims 放到用户级 PATH 首位（bootstrap 会做），机器级条目（如 Oracle 的 javapath）需要管理员权限调整或让位

mise activate prepends the shims inside interactive sessions; to fix every context, put the shims first on the user PATH (bootstrap does this) — machine-level entries such as Oracle javapath need admin rights to change
'{tool}' 在磁盘上有 {total} 个副本，其中 {hidden} 个不在 PATH 上，无法被直接调用。被遮蔽的位置见下。
'{tool}' exists {total} times on disk; {hidden} cannot be reached through PATH (the hidden copies are listed below).
要固定用某一版就写进声明文件；不要靠 PATH 顺序记住它
Pin the version you want in a declaration file instead of relying on PATH order
发现自定义命名约定 '{shim}'（文件名里声明版本 {declared}，实际 {actual}）。这类约定不在任何标准里，必须写进声明文件否则会失传。

Found a naming convention: '{shim}' (the filename claims {declared}, the binary is actually {actual}). Conventions that live only in a filename are invisible to every tool — record it in a declaration file or it will be lost.
把这条约定登记到声明文件（mise.toml / .tool-versions）
Record it in a declaration file (mise.toml / .tool-versions)
用户级 PATH 里有{parts}。它们不改变解析结果，但会挤占 PATH 长度上限，并让「改了却没生效」这类问题更难查。
The user PATH contains {parts}. They do not change resolution, but they eat into the PATH length limit and hide “I changed it but nothing took effect” problems.
PATH 里有{parts}。它们不改变解析结果，但会让「改了却没生效」这类问题更难查。
PATH contains {parts}. They do not change resolution, but they hide “I changed it but nothing took effect” problems.
清理这些条目（重复条目可以直接删掉）

The deployed machine manifest ({deployed}) differs from the repo template. The template is the state this machine wants; while they drift, tools added to the template are never installed.

本机设置了 XDG_CONFIG_HOME={xdg}，mise 的全局配置目录会跟着搬到这里（{config}）。后果是 ~/.config/mise/config.toml 不再是全局配置，而是「从工作目录向上发现」的配置——工作目录不在用户目录之下时它不生效。

XDG_CONFIG_HOME={xdg} is set, so mise moves its global config directory to {config}. As a result ~/.config/mise/config.toml is no longer the global config: it becomes a config discovered by walking up from the working directory, and has no effect outside the home tree.
要么去掉这个变量（推荐，机器声明就写在 ~/.config/mise/config.toml），要么把声明迁到 {config}
Either unset the variable (recommended: the manifest lives in ~/.config/mise/config.toml) or move the manifest to {config}
有 {count} 个工具/运行时放在非规范位置，且没有任何管理器纳管它们。它们只靠 PATH 被找到——PATH 一变就失传。建议登记到声明文件；今后新装的工具请落在 {root}。

{count} tool(s)/runtime(s) sit outside the canonical root and are tracked by no manager. They are reachable only through PATH, so a PATH change loses them. Record them in a declaration file; install future tools under {root}.
登记它们（不要搬动路径：路径可能被项目配置或 IDE 写死）
Record them — do not move the paths (project config or IDEs may hard-code them)
当前目录的 package.json 要求 node {wanted}，但没有任何工具读得到的声明文件。engines 只在版本不符时给警告，不会切换版本——这就是当初需要 node22.cmd 那类私有约定的原因。

This directory's package.json asks for node {wanted}, but no tool can read a declaration here. engines only warns on mismatch; it never switches versions — which is why private conventions like node22.cmd existed.
在项目根目录建 mise.toml（[tools] node = "22"）或 .tool-versions（nodejs 22）；之后 cd 进项目会自动用对版本
Add mise.toml ([tools] node = "22") or .tool-versions (nodejs 22) at the project root; from then on cd-ing in selects the right version
声明文件 '{file}' 要求 {tool} {wanted}，但本机没有发现它——既不在 PATH 上，也没有被任何管理器纳管。
'{file}' asks for {tool} {wanted}, but it was not found on this machine — not on PATH, and not managed by anything.

Install it with mise install (on a new machine, just run scripts/bootstrap.ps1)
执行 mise install 把它装上（新机器可直接跑 scripts/bootstrap.sh）

mise is not installed. Runtimes can only be resolved through PATH, so per-project version switching is unavailable.
